name: Benchmark V2 Set

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: "Number of tasks to run (1-10)"
        required: true
        default: "2"
        type: number
      agent:
        description: "Agent to use"
        required: true
        default: "swe-lancer"
        type: string
      provider:
        description: "Provider to use"
        required: true
        default: "openai"
        type: string
      model:
        description: "Model to use"
        required: true
        default: "gpt-4o"
        type: string
      timeout:
        description: "Timeout in seconds"
        required: true
        default: "3600"
        type: number

jobs:
  prepare-tasks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      task_ids: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.task_ids }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set task matrix
        id: set-matrix
        run: |
          # Read the top reward tasks from the checked-in JSON file
          # We use jq to slice the array based on the input count and output a JSON array string
          # The input is validated as a number by GitHub Actions, so it is safe to use in jq
          TASK_IDS_JSON=$(cat data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json | jq -c ".[:${{ github.event.inputs.task_count }}]")
          echo "task_ids=${TASK_IDS_JSON}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  run-benchmarks:
    needs: prepare-tasks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 1
      matrix:
        task_id: ${{ fromJson(needs.prepare-tasks.outputs.task_ids) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Run benchmark for task ${{ matrix.task_id }}
        env:
          TASK_ID: ${{ matrix.task_id }}
          AGENT: ${{ github.event.inputs.agent }}
          PROVIDER: ${{ github.event.inputs.provider }}
          MODEL: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}
          TIMEOUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.timeout }}
        run: |
          bun run benchmark:v2 \
            --task-id "$TASK_ID" \
            --agent "$AGENT" \
            --provider "$PROVIDER" \
            --model "$MODEL" \
            --timeout "$TIMEOUT"

      - name: Upload results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results-${{ matrix.task_id }}
          path: |
            results/
            logs/
